caption: The drawing is done in pencil on a light, off-white background and depicts a teacup with a matching saucer placed centrally in the lower half of the page. The teacup features a flared rim and is decorated with floral patterns consisting of multiple flowers with detailed petals and stems. The handle of the cup has an intricate design, featuring circular elements and floral motifs. The saucer has a shallow circular depression in the center for the cup and gently curved edges. Above the main drawing, there are two technical line diagrams: one is a side profile view showing the cup's silhouette and the saucer's edge, and the other is a top view of the cup and saucer, with the cup’s handle represented as a straight line. The drawing includes a scale indication at the bottom left ("Scale 1'' = 1'") and a signature reading "Magnus S. Lawson" at the bottom right. The composition uses fine pencil shading and line work to illustrate the form and decorative details of the objects.
title: Silver Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
